title: fix(fields): a lookupAutofill written on a standalone form node's field is not run
body:
Fixes #36923

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — every page that teaches `lookupAutofill` teaches it as a key on the object's lookup field, read by the record form and the line-item grid, and none teaches it on a standalone form node, so nothing it says became false (git grep -i lookupAutofill over skills/ and content/docs/ at 47d5f695: skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md and relationships.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md and one eval in views-apps-actions-pages.json; content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx, the generated references, and two release pages)
Ruling-ref: 7138010812 on #36923, the maintainer, verbatim: 「同意 拒收（推荐）」

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在独立表单(不属于某个对象的记录表单)里,查找字段上手写的自动带值不再执行,选中记录后其它字段保持不变;记录表单和明细行表格照旧带值,币种保护不变。
- 为什么做:独立表单上的自动带值没有币种保护,可能把一种货币的金额静默填进另一种货币的字段;按你的裁决改为拒收。
- 出错会怎样:如果判断错了,记录表单里的自动带值会失效(测试已钉住它仍然生效);改动只在界面层,撤回本次合并即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:批准合并(本次声明为收窄改动,需维护者批准)

## What changes

Per the ruling on #36923 (comment 7138010812): a `lookupAutofill` written by hand on a field of a standalone `form` node is not run. The pick still sets the lookup, but it copies nothing into other fields. Record forms and line-item grid columns keep the behaviour #36918 shipped, the cross-currency rule included.

- **How the widget tells a record form apart.** `LookupField` runs the declared pairs only on a lookup that carries the record form's stamp (`withLookupAutofillTargets`, applied by `stampRecordFormFields` in `gateFormFields`, the one step every record-form layout draws its fields through). No new public export, prop or context, and no new dependency edge.
- **The stamp is now complete.** Before, the record form stamped a lookup only when its field map named at least one target, so a missing stamp did not prove the host was not a record form. Now every lookup that declares pairs gets the stamp. The map is empty when the field map names none of the targets: the schema has not loaded, the form has no metadata source, or the target is not an object field. An empty map judges no currency, so those picks copy exactly as before.
- **Only an issued stamp counts.** The stamp map is registered in a module-private `WeakSet` when it is issued, which is the pattern `withRecordBeingEdited` already uses. A `lookupAutofillTargets` key written as data on a loose form field is not a stamp.
- **The refusal is visible.** A development build (the guard `globalThis.process?.env?.NODE_ENV !== 'production'`, the spelling `lookupRecordReference.ts` already ships) warns once per field, names the field, and says where the key is honoured.
- **Census and describe.** The form-field census row for `lookupAutofill` now says the key is honoured only in record forms and grid columns. The spec describe (`FieldSchema.lookupAutofill`, "Read wherever this field is picked: the record form, and a line-item grid column over it") already says this, so `packages/spec` is not touched.
- **Reach.** `lookupAutofill` has 0 non-test hits under `examples/` and `ui/examples/` at 6c1dfb34. The first dev report on the card measured HotCRM: 0 `type: 'form'` nodes.

## Breaking: two published surfaces narrow

The seat ruled on 2026-11-24 that this is a narrowing. The changeset carries two BREAKING banners and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

**The widest one is the `lookup` / `master_detail` widget (`LookupField`) handed `onAutofill`.**

- FROM: a single-value pick, and the opening fill of a create form that opened with the lookup set, filled the declared targets whenever the host handed `onAutofill` (and no `onSelectRecord`) and the field carried `lookupAutofill` pairs.
- TO: it also needs the stamp `withLookupAutofillTargets` issues, which the record form applies to every field it draws. A host that hands `onAutofill` without that stamp sets the lookup and fills nothing, on a pick and on the opening fill alike. A standalone `form` node is one such host.
- Fix: stamp the field through `withLookupAutofillTargets(field, objectFields)` before handing it to the widget, passing the object's field map as the record form does. With no map the stamp names no target, so the pick copies without the cross-currency rule, which is the copy this change stops. Or declare `lookupAutofill` on the object field and draw the object's record form.
- The published prop doc `FieldWidgetProps.onAutofill` (`widgets/types.ts`) now names the stamp. The same sentence in `plugin-grid`'s `relationalMetaKeys.ts` `lookupAutofill` note is corrected too.

**`readLookupAutofillTargets`** is a published export of `@object-ui/fields` (re-exported through `export *`). It no longer returns a target map it used to return.

- FROM: `readLookupAutofillTargets(field)` returned any non-array object found under the field's `lookupAutofillTargets` key.
- TO: it returns only the map `withLookupAutofillTargets` stamped, which is what the record form does. A same-name key written by hand reads `undefined`. `withLookupAutofillTargets` now also stamps a lookup whose pairs name no field of the map it is given, with an empty map. The map is frozen, and a field with pairs always comes back as a copy.
- Fix: stamp the field through `withLookupAutofillTargets`, as the record form does. If you need the raw value, read `field.lookupAutofillTargets` directly.

**What the marker rests on.** The changeset body carries a code-level prescription: the FROM, TO and Fix lines, written without an arrow. So the gate admits `no-migration-prescription` on a detector miss, not on a checked fact. No fact-based category covers a runtime function whose behaviour narrows: `runtime-interface-only` reads exported types, and `runtime-export-retired` reads an export that is gone. The vocabulary gap is #37136. The marker's own reason says this.

## Fix round 1

CI `Test UI (2/16)` was red at 6c1dfb34 because of this PR. `relationalMetaCopySet.derivation.test.ts` found that LookupField's dev warning read `name` off the field meta, a read that `RELATIONAL_META_READ_SET` does not classify for `lookup-editor`. The warning now takes the field name from the props or the form entry (`props.name || lookupField?.name`), which is the same read the trigger's test id already makes. So the table needs no new row and the derivation test is unchanged.

## Fix round 2

- `origin/main` merged in at 952484e2 (37 commits; clean). Scoped re-checks followed: the seven @objectstack builds, `@objectstack/spec check:generated` (spec moved on main), and type-check and tests for `fields`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-grid` and the schema catalog. `fields` and `plugin-grid` also moved on main.
- S1: `FieldWidgetProps.onAutofill` names the stamp, the changeset adds a BREAKING banner for `LookupField` with `onAutofill`, and the `relationalMetaKeys.ts` note is corrected.
- S2: the marker's reason now says what it rests on, and names #37136.
- The ablations were re-run at 47d5f695 (below).

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lookupAutofillStandaloneForm-36923.test.tsx`, 8 cases:
- bare `form` node: a pick copies nothing, and the dev warning fires once, naming the field, across two picks; a production build copies nothing and warns nothing; a hand-written `lookupAutofillTargets` does not opt the field in;
- stamp unit pins: stamped with no field map or with a map that names no target; a field without pairs is not stamped; the key written as data reads as no stamp;
- record form (`ObjectForm`): a USD quote fills the price and description with no note and no warning; a EUR quote fills the description and withholds the price with the note;
- grid column (`GridField`, `planLookupAutofill` path): a cell pick fills the declared target.

<details><summary>Ablations at 47d5f695 (vitest resolves @object-ui/* to src through the ui alias map, so no dist leg)</summary>

Each was run through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock. The mutation is verified on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed) and the restore is verified (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). After all three, `git diff HEAD` is empty.

1. LookupField gate removed (`autofillPairs = declaredPairs`): 3 failed, 5 passed. The three standalone pins fail with `expected '100' to be ''` (twice) and `expected 'A widget' to be ''`. The record-form, grid and unit pins stay green. Blob 1b68e764, restored to 01485cad.
2. Issued check removed from `readLookupAutofillTargets`: 2 failed, 6 passed. The forged-stamp pin fails with `expected '100' to be ''`, and the data-key unit pin fails with `expected {} to be undefined`. Restored to 83b9b5ba.
3. Empty-stamp change reverted (no stamp without a target): 1 failed, 7 passed. The stamp unit pin fails with `expected undefined to deeply equal {}`. Restored to 83b9b5ba.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The record form now stamps an empty `lookupAutofillTargets` on a lookup whose pairs name no field of the map. It used to leave such a lookup unstamped. The empty map carries no currency context, so the copy and the opening-fill timing are unchanged there.
- `readLookupAutofillTargets` (exported) now answers only for a stamp `withLookupAutofillTargets` issued. Its only in-tree reader is `LookupField`.
- `withLookupAutofillTargets` now freezes the map it stamps, and a field with pairs always comes back as a copy, even with no target. No in-tree caller writes to the map or compares the return to its argument.
- The stamp rests on module identity, through a module-private `WeakSet`. If a page ever loads two instances of `@object-ui/fields` (it ships both `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`), a stamp issued by one is no stamp to the `LookupField` of the other. Record-form autofill would then stop, with only the development warning to say so. `withRecordBeingEdited` already carries the same exposure on main, so this is a recorded cost, not a new class.
- The production guard was measured. The console's Vite (8.3.5), with the console's `define` block (`'process.env': {}`, `process.platform`, `process.version`), was run on a probe entry. An app build rewrites `globalThis.process?.env?.NODE_ENV` the same way it rewrites `process.env.NODE_ENV`: `--mode production` folds both to the production branch, and `--mode development` folds both to the development branch. So the warning is dead code in the console's production bundle, and the spelling stays as `lookupRecordReference.ts` ships it. A library-mode build rewrites neither spelling, which leaves both to the consuming app's bundler.
- The `recordFormStamp.ts` header said a standalone node's lookup "copies as it always did". That comment was made false by this change, so it is corrected.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, the `declaredPairs` / `autofillTargets` / `currencyTargets` hunk: the gate, plus the currency context kept off for an empty stamp.
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupAutofill.ts`, `withLookupAutofillTargets` / `readLookupAutofillTargets`: always stamp, issued-only read.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFormStamp.ts`: header only.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lookupAutofillStandaloneForm-36923.test.tsx`. Expected result: 8 passed.
